a: Longer random passwords beat complex short ones; prefer passphrases.
Attackers try leaked username/password pairs; use MFA and breach detection.
Single-use, short-lived, high-entropy tokens sent over secure channels.
Issue a new session id after successful login.
Expire idle sessions; absolute timeouts bound long-lived sessions.
Offer view/revoke active sessions for account security.
Long-lived remember-me tokens need rotation and theft detection.
Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite for session cookies.
Invalidate all server sessions and refresh tokens on demand.
Encourage password managers; never block paste in password fields.
